title: Chapter 241 Strange Alchemist
content:
Chapter 241 Strange Alchemist

After a brief thought, Lu Daosheng decided to find a ready-made alchemist.

Although Huangcheng does not need an alchemist, all of that is based on one's own situation.

And you should know that Lu Daosheng himself created more than one wasteland city.

Basically, every world you come to has a deserted city.

Thinking of this, Lu Daosheng made up his mind.

If others have it, his deserted city will naturally not be bad.

Immediately, Lu Daosheng sat cross-legged on the ground, and his spiritual consciousness suddenly rushed towards all directions like a tide.

In just a moment, Lu Daosheng's spiritual consciousness covered the entire Wood Immortal Realm, and then ignored the restrictions and directly penetrated into the Immortal Realm and even the other four realms.

However, this despicable act of creatures in the world cannot perceive.

Even the strong men who stood at the peak of the fairy world only noticed a slight discomfort, but the source was unknown at all.

In this way, the entire fairy world appeared in Lu Daosheng's mind without any concealment.

Lu Daosheng did not hesitate and directly began to screen one by one at an extremely terrifying speed until he found the goal he wanted.

"Haha, there are quite a few people in this world who are not serious."

After a while, Lu Daosheng finally found an alchemist who basically met his conditions.

However, the other party seems to be more than just an alchemist.

After a moment of silence, Lu Daosheng shook his head slightly.

"Does the other party do what it is, as long as you can refine the alchemy."

Immediately, Lu Daosheng leaned out his hand and gently stroked forward, and the space in front of him was directly cracked, revealing a space tunnel.

Lu Daosheng took a step forward and disappeared from the spot.

At the same time, at a crater with magma rolling in the Fire Fairy Realm.

The temperature here has reached a terrifying height, with some strange flames burning around it, and it is even mixed with the power of the fire-type laws, which is extremely terrifying.

I'm afraid that ordinary Immortal Emperor Realm powerhouses should not stay in this environment for too long.

And now, a figure in a tattered black robe is staring at the rolling magma in the crater with a fiery face.

"Immortal Flame Grass, I've seen you, come to my pot."

The black robe figure took out a big black pot, and the disgusting aura inside suddenly filled the entire crater.

Gulugulu.

At this time, the magma in the crater suddenly began to rise continuously, and in a moment, the entire volcano began to tremble wildly.

The volcano is about to erupt!

However, the black robe figure was not afraid at all, but was a little excited.

"Here, come!"

The black robe figure raised his hands high and began to dance wildly at the crater.

The next moment.

boom!

As a pillar of magma rose into the sky and entered the sky, the entire volcano fell into a shaking and empty space.

Taking advantage of this gap, the black robe figure did not hesitate at all. He ignored the terrifying magma and rushed straight into the crater.

And when he appeared outside the crater again, a burning flame and bright red grass appeared in his hand.

This is his goal, Fairy Flame Grass.

At the same time, the rolling magma in the void also began to fall rapidly.

Seeing this, the black robe figure faintly put the black pot beside her on her head, and then rushed out of the range of the volcanic eruption.

......

A moment later, in a dilapidated village.

The whole village was extremely quiet, with no sound except for the slightest sound of insects.

It seems that there is no one in this village at all.

But at this moment, a squeak in a small earthen house that was quite complete.

The door is open.

A young woman with a fair face and a black dress walked out of the room, then sat on the doorstep, supported her face with her hands, and looked outside with a dull look, as if she was waiting for someone to return.

I don't know how long it took.

A crisp sound of footsteps sounded from outside.

The woman suddenly moved slightly, stood up suddenly, staring outside with a vigilant look on her face.

The next moment, a strange man appeared in front of her.

The man was very handsome, but it gave her a very terrifying feeling. Just standing there, she was already a little afraid to move.

"Who are you?"

The woman's pleasant voice sounded, but the woman's fear was felt in her tone.

Hearing this, the man smiled slightly, "Don't be nervous, I have no malice."

The man is Lu Daosheng.

He came to find the alchemist who meets his conditions.

However, it is not the one in front of you.

But just Lu Daosheng's words can make a woman relax her vigilance.

"Are you here to find my master?"

When Lu Daosheng heard this question, he was a little surprised. This little girl is quite smart.

However, after careful consideration, my purpose is not too difficult to guess.

No, he is here to find the little girl in front of him.

Seeing Lu Daosheng's expression change, the woman also breathed a sigh of relief in her heart, then turned around and entered the room.

The next moment, the woman walked out with a teacup and a teapot.

"You come to see my master, I must have known it all, so let's sit down and wait first. I don't know when my master will be able to come back."

Lu Daosheng didn't put on airs and sat directly on the stone bench in the yard.

Looking at the steaming tea in front of him, Lu Daosheng picked up a cup and then took a sip.

"Your master will be back soon."

Lu Daosheng said softly.

"Tsk, this tea is pretty good."

When he heard Lu Daosheng's words, the woman in the black dress was shocked and looked at the man in front of her with a serious face.

The waiting time was a bit long, and Lu Daosheng felt a little regretful. If he had known that guy was so stupid, he would have gone to find him directly.

Why are you squatting at his house?

But waiting was also waiting, Lu Daosheng simply chatted with the woman in front of him.

From the chat, Lu Daosheng also learned the woman's name.

Round.

This is her name, very simple.

"Have you always lived with your master?"

“Yes, it’s been many years.”

"Then your relationship must be very good."

However, in the face of this problem, the woman was silent.

Seeing this, Lu Daosheng just drank tea again and said nothing.

In this way, another time passed.

A treacherous laugh suddenly sounded from outside.

"Jiehahahahahaha, Xiao Yuanzi, I'm back!"

Immediately, an old man with a ragged body and a dirty face walked into the yard with great strides.

It is hard to believe that such an old man is the master of the fair little girl in front of him.

But the old man seemed to have not seen Lu Daosheng in the yard. He just held the fairy flame grass in his hand and kicked the stool under Yuanyuan. Qinghe said, "What are you doing when you stand there? Why don't you roll in and help me?"

Hearing this, Yuanyuan didn't say anything, but just stood up lightly and then walked into the house.
